turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Thank you for seeing me. I have twenty minutes.

I'll be direct. You entered a zero before you called me. I'd like to know why.

Owen says he wrote that essay himself. I'm not here to argue about Owen. I'm here to understand what you actually have.

What is the 94% score, exactly? Which tool produced it? And what else do you have besides that number?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.

Good. Let's look.

Show me the printout of the checker's report first. Not just the number.

Which passages did it flag? Is it the whole essay, or particular paragraphs?

And I'd like the date and time it was run. Which version of the essay did you scan?

Before we go further, is the zero in the gradebook now? Can Owen or anyone in his class see it?
You're very sharp, you know that?

That's kind. It doesn't answer my question.

Is the zero visible to the class? Yes or no.

And the report. Can I see it?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.

Flattery won't move me, Mr. Hale.

But you said "timestamp issue." What is it? Be specific.

Was the essay scanned before or after Owen submitted it? What are the dates?

If you have it written down, show me. I'd like to check it myself.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.

I can see why you looked at it. A flag is a reason to look.

It isn't a reason to enter a zero. Not before you called me. Not before Owen could answer.

So here's what I need. Show me the report. Show me the dates.

And tell me this. Is the zero visible to his class right now?
